title: Ash-Sash Challenger
text: Ash-Sash Challenger marks the road as a dueling floor and answers hesitation with a hooked saber. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The sash is older than the hand holding the blade.

defeatReward.text: Ash-Sash Challenger is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
